endorsements.quote: Clinically, twin outputs must be brief, explainable, and embedded in EMRs—initially deployed in “shadow mode” so clinicians can compare model output with clinical judgment.

unlisted_practices: Conduct staged model training beginning with retrospective validation on existing datasets, followed by shadow-mode deployment, and finally supervised implementation with clear uncertainty quantification.
Obtain informed consent and communicate transparently about system limitations when deploying learning health system AI.
Establish ethical oversight with patient representation and bioethicists for digital twin learning health systems.
Adopt a common-data model early and automate validation with uncertainty safeguards for real-time inference across many digital twins.
Use layered, cost-effective biomarker subsets that combine low-throughput high-information markers with cheap high-frequency data streams.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/viewpoint paper proposing a conceptual framework (Digital Twin Learning Health Systems using CHOIR) to transform pain care, rather than an empirical study.
